text:
```artifact
@startuml
actor User
participant "Edit/Update Chemist/Labs Screen" as ChemistScreen
participant "Prescriptions" as Prescriptions
participant "Database" as DB

== TC-001: Edit Chemist/Lab Details ==
User -> ChemistScreen: Query Chemist/Lab Id
ChemistScreen -> DB: Retrieve Chemist/Lab Details
DB --> ChemistScreen: Chemist/Lab Details
ChemistScreen --> User: Display Chemist/Lab Details
User -> ChemistScreen: Modify Chemist/Lab Details
ChemistScreen -> DB: Update Chemist/Lab Details
DB --> ChemistScreen: Confirmation
ChemistScreen --> User: Display Confirmation

== TC-002: Chemist/Lab Does Not Exist ==
User -> ChemistScreen: Query Non-Existent Chemist/Lab Id
ChemistScreen -> DB: Retrieve Chemist/Lab Details
DB --> ChemistScreen: No Data Found
ChemistScreen --> User: Display Error "Chemist or Lab does not exist"

== TC-003: Delete Chemist/Lab with Open Prescriptions ==
User -> ChemistScreen: Query Chemist/Lab Id
ChemistScreen -> DB: Retrieve Chemist/Lab Details
DB --> ChemistScreen: Chemist/Lab Details
ChemistScreen -> Prescriptions: Check Open Requests
Prescriptions --> ChemistScreen: Open Requests Found
ChemistScreen --> User: Display Error "Chemist or Lab has open Prescription Requests - cannot delete"

== TC-004: Delete Chemist/Lab without Open Prescriptions ==
User -> ChemistScreen: Query Chemist/Lab Id
ChemistScreen -> DB: Retrieve Chemist/Lab Details
DB --> ChemistScreen: Chemist/Lab Details
ChemistScreen -> Prescriptions: Check Open Requests
Prescriptions --> ChemistScreen: No Open Requests
ChemistScreen -> DB: Delete Chemist/Lab Details
DB --> ChemistScreen: Confirmation
ChemistScreen --> User: Display Confirmation

actor Admin
participant "Symptoms Screen" as SymptomsScreen

== TC-005: Add Symptom Code ==
Admin -> SymptomsScreen: Add Symptom Code
SymptomsScreen --> Admin: Display Add Symptom Code Screen
Admin -> SymptomsScreen: Enter Symptom Code, Symptom Description
SymptomsScreen -> DB: Save Symptom Code, Symptom Description
DB --> SymptomsScreen: Confirmation
SymptomsScreen --> Admin: Display Confirmation

== TC-006: Edit Symptom Code ==
Admin -> SymptomsScreen: Query Symptom Code
SymptomsScreen -> DB: Retrieve Symptom Details
DB --> SymptomsScreen: Symptom Details
SymptomsScreen --> Admin: Display Symptom Details
Admin -> SymptomsScreen: Modify Symptom Details
SymptomsScreen -> DB: Update Symptom Details
DB --> SymptomsScreen: Confirmation
SymptomsScreen --> Admin: Display Confirmation

== TC-007: Symptom Code Does Not Exist ==
Admin -> SymptomsScreen: Query Non-Existent Symptom Code
SymptomsScreen -> DB: Retrieve Symptom Details
DB --> SymptomsScreen: No Data Found
SymptomsScreen --> Admin: Display Error "Symptom does not exist"

actor Patient
participant "Patient Profile Screen" as PatientScreen

== TC-008: Register New Patient ==
Patient -> PatientScreen: Register New Patient
PatientScreen --> Patient: Display Registration Screen
Patient -> PatientScreen: Enter Patient Id, Name, Age, Sex, Address, Contact Details
PatientScreen -> DB: Save Patient Details
DB --> PatientScreen: Confirmation
PatientScreen --> Patient: Display Confirmation
@enduml
```
